# Welcome — read this first

Thanks for stopping by. This is the discussion space for **Danger Close**, a browser-based retirement stress-test console. Whether you're using the tool, curious about the math, or have an idea, you're in the right place.

## ⚠️ The one hard rule: never post real financial data

This space is **public**. Anyone on the internet can read it, and search engines index it.

- **Do not post real balances, incomes, account numbers, or your API key** — not in a discussion, not in a comment, not in a screenshot.
- To ask about a specific result, **use rounded or made-up numbers**, or load the built-in **Example Data** (the "USE EXAMPLE DATA" button) and describe what you see there. Example Data is enough to reproduce and discuss almost anything.
- If you post something sensitive by accident, delete the whole post promptly and let me know — editing alone isn't always enough, since history can be retained.

## This is an educational tool, not financial advice

Danger Close is a hobby project built by one person with **no financial credentials**. It renders no investment advice and recommends no securities. Every output should be checked independently before you act on it. Nothing said here changes that.

## Before you post

- **"Why is my success rate lower than [other calculator]?"** — This is by design and fully explained in **[METHODOLOGY.md](../blob/main/METHODOLOGY.md)**. The base scenario is deliberately more pessimistic than history because the tool's job is stress-testing. Try switching the scenario to `HISTORICAL` and see how much of the gap closes.
- **Found a bug?** Bugs go in **[Issues](../issues)**, not here — there's a template that walks you through it.
- **Everything else** — questions, methodology debates, ideas — is welcome here. Pick the category that fits best.

## Where things go

- 🙋 **Q&A — Using the tool** — how do I model something, how do I read a result
- 🧮 **Methodology & the math** — why a number is what it is, debating an assumption
- 💡 **Ideas** — features you'd like to see
- 🗣️ **General** — anything else

Welcome aboard.
